title: Mean of odd-dimensional majority
statement: For every natural number $m$, consider majority on sign vectors of length $2m+1$: it returns $1$ when the sum of the coordinates is nonnegative and $-1$ otherwise. The mean of this function under the uniform product distribution on the sign cube is zero.
hypotheses_covered: The distribution is the product of uniform distributions on the two signs
